capabilities: browse Yandex Disk folders in a dedicated side panel
upload vault files to Yandex Disk
download cloud files into the vault
preview supported images from the cloud
route desktop traffic through HTTP CONNECT, HTTPS CONNECT, or SOCKS5 proxies
disambiguation: Not a background sync service; file movement is manual upload and download through a browser panel.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Version 1.0.5 is a release candidate; the README warns that the OAuth token and optional proxy password are stored locally in data.json and should never be shared.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse or transfer files with Yandex Disk, so users must switch to a separate app to move vault files to and from that cloud.

relations.evidence: connects your vault to Yandex Disk cloud storage

summary: Cloud file bridge that browses Yandex Disk folders, uploads vault files, downloads cloud files, previews images, and supports desktop proxies.
